lines: Hard Rock (Florida) prices only: player rebounds, points, assists and 3-pointers made, the main line, over or under. No leg worse than -200.
Step 1, the gap: Hard Rock's price must be at least 3% better than the middle of 4+ other books on the same line, and Pinnacle (the sharpest book) must not disagree.
Step 2, the guard: our own model for that stat gets a 20% say. If the blend falls under +2% value, no pick. The model can block a pick, never create one.
Prices are checked about 90, 45 and 20 minutes before each tip (plus a morning look). The price shown is frozen and is the one graded.
A player listed Out or Doubtful is never picked. Questionable or game-time decision waits until he is cleared or confirmed starting. Needs 10+ games of history.
Early = injury news still open. Injury report clear = he and his team's main rotation are cleared. Starters confirmed = both teams' starting fives are posted.
If a later check finds the edge gone, the pick is pulled and says what that means if you already bet it. Pulled picks stay on the Record.
One side per player per market. No cap per game or per night: every leg that clears both checks is shown, best first. No parlays.
Graded after the game at the shown price, 1 unit flat. Overtime counts. Did not play = void.
New picks stop by themselves if the Record falls to -10 units.
